title: Comparative Study of Rohto Dry-Aid® and Systane® Ultra in Patients With Dry Eye
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of Rohto Dry-Aid® in comparison to Systane® Ultra on visual function and tear film stability in patients diagnosed with Dry Eye.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be at least 18 years of age
* Provide written informed consent
* Have a reported history of dry eye
* Have a history of use of eye drops for dry eye symptoms
* Ocular discomfort
* Conjunctival redness
* Tear film break up time
* Corneal and Conjunctival Staining

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have any clinically significant slit lamp findings at entry visit
* Be diagnosed with an ongoing ocular infection
* Have any planned ocular and/or lid surgeries over the study period
* Have an uncontrolled systemic disease
* Be a woman who is pregnant, nursing or planning a pregnancy
* Be a woman of childbearing potential who is not using an acceptable means of birth control
* Have a known allergy and/or sensitivity to the test article or its components
* Have a condition or be in a situation which the investigator feels may put the subject at significant risk, may confound the study results, or may interfere significantly with the subject's participation in the study
